Subject: Re: MAP: execution & paperwork wrangle for Orion Healthware — redlines

Folks —

I reviewed the SOW and produced a redline (SOW_Orion_redline.pdf). Summary of material items:
- Payment milestone: recommend moving from net-30 after invoice to net-45 for first invoice (customer asked for 30; propose net-45 for first 30 days of onboarding to align onboarding effort).
- Data residency / retention: we can confirm 90-day logs retention; add small clause and SLA for audit traces.
- Liability cap: propose $1M aggregate; if they request higher we will need exec approval.
- Start date buffer: require 10 business days after signature for provisioning if Dedicated capacity ordered.

If we want to preserve the 6/19 signature aim, we should keep redlines minimal and raise the liability cap discussion to execs right away (Aditya, can you escalate if they push?).

Attached: SOW_Orion_redline.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

I've attached an updated MAP with the retention line. If everyone is aligned on Thu then we will push the SOW to final and initiate DocuSign the same day.

Thanks,
Monica
